patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: green hydrogen = electrolysis of water (2023 AMVI), NGHM approval date 4 January 2023 (2022 non-gazetted, twice).
APPSC-G1 favours 'firsts' and incorrect-statement items: hydrogen ferry by Cochin Shipyard; fuel-cell bus trap 'Veera Vahana' and 'H2 + CO2' as wrong statements.
AP tilt: AP Green Hydrogen & Green Ammonia Policy 2023 statement question (NREDCAP nodal, MTPA targets, third-party RE sourcing).
UPSC-style items test uses (IC engine, natural-gas blending, fuel cells) and hard-to-abate sectors (fertiliser, refineries, steel) and the 50 MMT GHG abatement figure.

App MCQs go much deeper into scheme numbers (SIGHT/SHIP outlays, GHCI, electrolyser types, SECI prices) and multi-statement/match formats than the PYQs show; many filed PYQs are generic chemistry unrelated to the topic.
